entries.title: Cleanup offers name what finished tasks left
entries.body: When a finished task’s heavy run still holds a computer’s line while other runs wait, the first mate now offers the same cleanup look it offers when memory runs short. Both offers can name what the app recorded: a stop that failed when a task finished, or a program that kept running. After you pick one, the look runs the recorded stop again, or ends the program only if it is still the same one.
entries.noPicture: The offer is written for each computer’s current leftovers, not a fixed app view.
